say:0:1310802001:0.text: That's strange. Why are they still worrying about the ice sculpture?
say:0:1310802001:0.source_cn: 好奇怪，他们怎么还在焦虑冰雕的事情？

say:1:1310802002:0.text: They might be in a time loop too...
say:1:1310802002:0.source_cn: 也许他们也陷入时间的循环了……
say:1:1310802002:0.male: They might be in a time loop too...
say:1:1310802002:0.female: They might be in a time loop too...

say:1:1310803001:0.text: Excuse me, if we leave from the exit there, it'll lead us to the ancient battlefield, right?
say:1:1310803001:0.source_cn: 请问……从前面的洞口出去，是通往古战场的对吗？

say:2:1310803002:0.text: I don't know if I can finish everything... What? Did you just say something?
say:2:1310803002:0.source_cn: 快要忙死了，做不完了，做不完了……啊，你刚问什么？

say:4:1310803003:0.text: Oh, are you all busy making an ice sculpture? Is it for the festival?
say:4:1310803003:0.source_cn: 呃，你们是在忙着做冰雕？祭典的冰雕？

say:5:1310803004:0.text: Isn't it obvious? The lighting ceremony is tomorrow, and the sculpture isn't even half finished! Ah, stop bothering me. I still have so much work to do.
say:5:1310803004:0.source_cn: 这不明摆着的吗？明天就要点火仪式了，冰雕还差半个头盔没...

say:6:1310803005:1.text: Well, we just asked if we'd find the ancient battlefield if we go through that exit over there.
say:6:1310803005:1.source_cn: 那个，我们就是想问问，从那边的洞口出去就能到古战场吗？

say:8:1310803006:0.text: Yeah... Hey! What are you brats trying to go there for? You'll get eaten by the undead if you aren't careful. None of us have time to go save you!
say:8:1310803006:0.source_cn: 对……唉？你们几个小孩子往那边跑什么，小心被活死人吃了...

choice_prompt:9:1310803006.text: Yeah... Hey! What are you brats trying to go there for? You'll get eaten by the undead if you aren't careful. None of us have time to go save you!
choice_prompt:9:1310803006.source_cn: 对……唉？你们几个小孩子往那边跑什么，小心被活死人吃了，咱可没工夫救你们！

say:10:1310803007:0.text: Well, yeah. Of course. There are some flooded ruins in that direction. Word is that a bunch of undead are roaming around over there.
say:10:1310803007:0.source_cn: 有，怎么没有！那边深处还有些淹了水的古遗迹，听说大部分...
say:10:1310803007:0.male: Well, yeah. Of course. There are some flooded ruins in that direction. Word is that a bunch of undead are roaming around over there.
say:10:1310803007:0.female: Well, yeah. Of course. There are some flooded ruins in that direction. Word is that a bunch of undead are roaming around over there.

say:11:1310803009:0.text: Listen here before you run off. Life is worth living. Keep that sense of adventure in check. If danger finds you out there, don't come crying to me.
say:11:1310803009:0.source_cn: 咱说你们几个，命重要，别老想着搞什么冒险刺激的，等遇着...

say:12:1310803010:0.text: Ah! How did I end up talking to you for so long? I gotta get back to work.
say:12:1310803010:0.source_cn: 哎呀！怎么就跟你们扯起来了，不行不行，咱得赶工去了。

say:13:1310803011:0.text: Tonight's gonna be a long night.
say:13:1310803011:0.source_cn: 唉，今晚上可要熬长夜咯！

choice:9:0:1.text: There are undead in these parts?
choice:9:0:1.male: There are undead in these parts?
choice:9:0:1.female: There are undead in these parts?

say:15:1310803008:0.text: No one dares to go that far out. The ruins there are flooded and full of the undead. If you have a death wish, feel free to go gallivanting in those parts.
say:15:1310803008:0.source_cn: 咱也没敢往深处去过，那边的遗迹废墟都让水淹了，还有活死...
say:15:1310803008:0.male: No one dares to go that far out. The ruins there are flooded and full of the undead. If you have a death wish, feel free to go gallivanting in those parts.
say:15:1310803008:0.female: No one dares to go that far out. The ruins there are flooded and full of the undead. If you have a death wish, feel free to go gallivanting in those parts.

say:0:1310804001:0.text: The other side of the mountain sounds dangerous...
say:0:1310804001:0.source_cn: 听起来山脉对面很危险呢……

say:1:1310804002:0.text: We're already here. Let's just take a quick look.
say:1:1310804002:0.source_cn: 来都来了，不管怎么样，先去看看再说！

say:0:1310804101:0.text: These ice crystals are so beautiful! They are more colorful and clear than the ones I've seen before.
say:0:1310804101:0.source_cn: 这些冰好漂亮！比普通的冰块更加晶莹剔透。

say:1:1310804102:0.text: Brrr! It's beautiful... but it's so cold here... Achoo! I hope the miners don't catch a cold...
say:1:1310804102:0.source_cn: 美是很美……可这里好冷啊……阿嚏！希望采矿的矮人朋友不...

say:0:1310806001:0.text: Hey, isn't that the mysterious woman at the ball? She might know something.
say:0:1310806001:0.source_cn: 咦，那不是舞会上的神秘女人吗？她或许知道些什么，我们去问问！

say:1:1310807001:0.text: Wait! Don't go! You were the one who scared the princess at the ball, weren't you?
say:1:1310807001:0.source_cn: 等等！你……你先别走！就是你在舞会上吓到了公主殿下！

say:2:1310807002:0.text: You were also the one who took away the Graveborn who pretended to work at the Ghostly Getaway.
say:2:1310807002:0.source_cn: 你好像也是带走鬼影密室里那个假扮员工的亡灵的人！

say:5:1310807003:1.text: What do you want? Look, I have no interest in apologizing to that "princess."
say:5:1310807003:1.source_cn: 你们有什么事？先说好，我没兴趣向那位“公主殿下”道歉。

say:6:1310807004:0.text: As for <style="highlight">Igor</style>, I have already instructed him not to caper around in human settlements. Rest assured he will do as he is told.

say:10:1310807007:0.text: And? Do not tell me you're trying to hunt me down like that silly wolf. Apologies, but I will not be captured without a fight.
say:10:1310807007:0.source_cn: 怎么，你也和那头傻狼一样，想要“狩猎”我吗？很抱歉，我...
say:10:1310807007:0.male: And? Do not tell me you're trying to hunt me down like that silly wolf. Apologies, but I will not be captured without a fight.
say:10:1310807007:0.female: And? Do not tell me you're trying to hunt me down like that silly wolf. Apologies, but I will not be captured without a fight.

say:11:1310807010:0.text: Listen well, the festival is over. I shall not visit the town again, and no one shall be left in fear. There is no cause for alarm.
say:11:1310807010:0.source_cn: 听着，祭典已经结束了，我不会再去镇子里，也不会再吓到任...

say:12:1310807011:0.text: The festival is over... Hey, you haven't been affected either!
say:12:1310807011:0.source_cn: 祭典结束……咦，你也没有受到影响！

say:13:1310807012:0.text: You must be connected to the time loop in Cedartown!
say:13:1310807012:0.source_cn: 所以……雪松镇的时间循环是不是和你有关？

say:14:1310807013:1.text: Wait, what are you talking about?

say:16:1310807015:0.text: Don't you know? Time is acting weird in Cedartown!
say:16:1310807015:0.source_cn: 你不知道吗？雪松镇陷入奇怪的时间循环里了！

say:17:1310807016:1.text: The people in town are still celebrating the festival. They don't remember what happened in the past few days. Everything seems to have returned to the beginning of the festival...
say:17:1310807016:1.source_cn: 镇上的人们还在庆祝祭典，他们对前几天的自己已经做过的事...

say:18:1310807017:0.text: Also, the ice sculpture, which was lit the other night, now looks like it hasn't even been unveiled yet.
say:18:1310807017:0.source_cn: 而且，明明已经点过火的冰雕，也变成了还没揭幕的样子。

say:19:1310807018:0.text: We're trying to get to the bottom of this mystery.

say:21:1310807020:1.text: We've found that you're the only one who's been unaffected, and all other Graveborn that appeared during the festival have disappeared!
say:21:1310807020:1.source_cn: 我们一路调查下来，只有你没有受到影响，而且所有之前祭典...

choice_prompt:22:1310807020.text: We've found that you're the only one who's been unaffected, and all other Graveborn that appeared during the festival have disappeared!
choice_prompt:22:1310807020.source_cn: 我们一路调查下来，只有你没有受到影响，而且所有之前祭典上出现的亡灵都不见了！

say:23:1310807021:1.text: You suspect that I caused the time loop?
say:23:1310807021:1.source_cn: 你们认为是我造成了时间循环？

say:24:1310807022:0.text: Who am I...? If you must know...
say:24:1310807022:0.source_cn: 我的身份……好吧，如果你们一定要知道的话……

say:26:1310807008:0.text: If you mean the ball, then I admit I was quite the disruption, and I apologize. However, other than that, I did nothing else.
say:26:1310807008:0.source_cn: 扰乱……如果你说的是舞会，那我承认，而且对此感到抱歉。...
say:26:1310807008:0.male: If you mean the ball, then I admit I was quite the disruption, and I apologize. However, other than that, I did nothing else.
say:26:1310807008:0.female: If you mean the ball, then I admit I was quite the disruption, and I apologize. However, other than that, I did nothing else.

say:27:1310807009:0.text: Although I am undead, I bear no ill will toward humans.
say:27:1310807009:0.source_cn: 虽然我是……你们口中的“活死人”，但我对人类并没有什么恶意。
say:27:1310807009:0.male: Although I am undead, I bear no ill will toward humans.
say:27:1310807009:0.female: Although I am undead, I bear no ill will toward humans.

say:2:1310808002:0.text: Are you really the hero that the festival was honoring?
say:2:1310808002:0.source_cn: 你真的是那位女将军，是祭典上纪念的那位英雄？！

say:5:1310808003:1.text: What your eyes behold is what you see.
say:5:1310808003:1.source_cn: 你所见的就是你所见的。

say:6:1310808004:0.text: Aren't you the general who fought against that Hypogean? How did you become a Graveborn?
say:6:1310808004:0.source_cn: 你不是对抗恶魔的英雄吗， 为什么会变成亡灵？

say:7:1310808005:0.text: What happened to you...? Do the undead really have nothing to do with the time loop?
say:7:1310808005:0.source_cn: 你身上究竟发生了什么事？你……活死人真的和时间循环没有...

choice_prompt:8:1310808005.text: What happened to you...? Do the undead really have nothing to do with the time loop?
choice_prompt:8:1310808005.source_cn: 你身上究竟发生了什么事？你……活死人真的和时间循环没有关系吗？

say:9:1310808006:1.text: You call me a general, a hero, and one of the undead... I'm done being defined by these words. My name is Valka.
say:9:1310808006:1.source_cn: 呵……将军、英雄、活死人……我受够这些词了。它们都不是...

say:10:1310808007:0.text: Yes, two thousand years ago, I fought in the Divine War against the Hypogeans... I was a knight once. I swore to protect the people with my life, and this oath was never broken, even in death.
say:10:1310808007:0.source_cn: 没错，我曾经和恶魔战斗过，在两千年以前……我曾是个骑士...

say:11:1310808008:0.text: So, hear me now. Although I have succumbed to becoming a Graveborn, this filthy undead creature that humans despise, I would never do anything to harm the innocent.
say:11:1310808008:0.source_cn: 所以，你们听好了：即便我现在是亡灵，是你们口中污秽可怖...

say:12:1310808009:0.text: I am not a minion of the Hypogeans, and neither are any of the undead here!
say:12:1310808009:0.source_cn: 我不是什么恶魔的眷属，这里所有的活死人都不是！

say:13:1310808010:1.text: But all the townsfolk in Cedartown said that the undead are working for the Hypogeans...
say:13:1310808010:1.source_cn: 但是雪松镇的镇民说，活死人是恶魔的属下……

say:14:1310808011:0.text: ... Do you know the origins of the undead that linger here?
say:14:1310808011:0.source_cn: ……你们知道这里的活死人是怎么来的吗？

say:15:1310808012:0.text: No, we don't... At least, Chippy doesn't.

say:16:1310808013:1.text: If you desire the truth, then come with me.
say:16:1310808013:1.source_cn: 跟我来吧，如果你们必须要一个解释，那我就给你们真相。

say:0:1310810001:0.text: Let us proceed by boat. It's the only way to reach the ruins of the ancient battlefield.
say:0:1310810001:0.source_cn: 上船吧，需要划船才能去古战场遗迹。

say:1:1310814001:0.source_cn: 那些活死人，他们还是会主动发起攻击……

say:2:1310814002:0.text: Why are you different from them, Valka?
say:2:1310814002:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，为什么你和他们不同？

say:3:1310814003:0.text: I'm also one of the undead. I am not so different. They were all warriors... the bravest and most loyal warriors I knew.
say:3:1310814003:0.source_cn: 和他们不同？别忘了，我也是你们口中的“活死人”。而且…...

say:5:1310814004:0.text: You mean they all fought in the Divine War?
say:5:1310814004:0.source_cn: 你是说，他们曾经参加过神魔战争？

say:6:1310814005:1.text: Indeed, they were all under my banner. We stood shoulder to shoulder in defense of this land, yet now we are scorned by those we sought to protect. Is this not a cruel jest?
say:6:1310814005:1.source_cn: 他们都曾在我的麾下，同我并肩作战，守卫这片土地。但现在...

choice_prompt:7:1310814005.text: Indeed, they were all under my banner. We stood shoulder to shoulder in defense of this land, yet now we are scorned by those we sought to protect. Is this not a cruel jest?
choice_prompt:7:1310814005.source_cn: 他们都曾在我的麾下，同我并肩作战，守卫这片土地。但现在我们却被这里的人们诅咒和厌弃……真可笑，是不是？

say:8:1310814006:0.text: ... Understand that war changes all things.
say:8:1310814006:0.source_cn: ……你应该知道，战争会改变一切。
say:8:1310814006:0.male: ... Understand that war changes all things.
say:8:1310814006:0.female: ... Understand that war changes all things.

say:9:1310814008:0.text: Can you tell what really happened back then?
say:9:1310814008:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，能给我们讲讲当时的事情吗？

say:10:1310814009:0.text: In the time that you have spent in Whiteridge, you must've encountered numerous tales concerning the First Divine War, have you not?
say:10:1310814009:0.source_cn: 你们来到白山这些天，应该没少听到关于第一次神魔战争的传说吧？

say:11:1310814010:0.text: Yes! The festival commemorating the war heroes, the special sapphirine blossom, the relics of the past… We learned of many things related to the war.
say:11:1310814010:0.source_cn: 嗯！纪念战争英雄的祭典，七瓣蓝绒花、花海里的遗迹和战士...

say:12:1310814011:1.text: Indeed, the war was so merciless that it was etched into the very blood of the people, a memory they dared not let fade.
say:12:1310814011:1.source_cn: 是啊……那场战争太惨烈了，惨烈到人们不得不将它刻印在血...

say:13:1310814012:0.text: In that bygone era, save for the infirm elderly and the tender youth, nearly all here girded themselves for war and marched to the battlefield, heedless of gender or lineage.
say:13:1310814012:0.source_cn: 那时候，除了走不动路的老人和年幼孩童，这里几乎所有的人...

say:14:1310814013:0.text: Yet, we were unable to withstand the onslaught of the Hypogeans. Their commander was unrivaled. We all called her the Frost Furie. With a mere snap of her fingers, she froze hundreds of warriors into fragments of ice.
say:14:1310814013:0.source_cn: 但我们还是无法抵抗恶魔的进攻，尤其是它们的首领——我们...

say:15:1310814014:0.text: We perished upon that battlefield. It was then that the God of Death appeared... He changed us into Graveborn, rekindling the flames of our resentment and regret, and allowed us to take up arms against the Hypogeans once more.
say:15:1310814014:0.source_cn: 我们战死沙场。直到死神大人出现……祂将我们转化为亡灵，...

choice_prompt:16:1310814014.text: We perished upon that battlefield. It was then that the God of Death appeared... He changed us into Graveborn, rekindling the flames of our resentment and regret, and allowed us to take up arms against the Hypogeans once more.
choice_prompt:16:1310814014.source_cn: 我们战死沙场。直到死神大人出现……祂将我们转化为亡灵，让我们可以再次燃烧心中的不甘和悔恨，可以拿起武器再次面对恶魔。

say:17:1310814015:0.text: Indeed, the Lord of Death himself... He stood before us and presented us with a choice. We chose to become Graveborn and continue the fight.
say:17:1310814015:0.source_cn: 是的，死神大人……祂突然出现，给了我们选择。而我们……...
say:17:1310814015:0.male: Indeed, the Lord of Death himself... He stood before us and presented us with a choice. We chose to become Graveborn and continue the fight.
say:17:1310814015:0.female: Indeed, the Lord of Death himself... He stood before us and presented us with a choice. We chose to become Graveborn and continue the fight.

say:18:1310814017:1.text: How come you're the only one who's able to be rational while the undead... Your companions lost all of their reasoning?
say:18:1310814017:1.source_cn: 可是，为什么现在你的神智还很清晰，但那些活死人……你的...

say:19:1310814018:1.text: After the war ended, the people slowly forgot the savagery it had wrought. Through the generations, peace returned to the land. However, our memories remain fresh. We have carried these wounds for two thousand years.
say:19:1310814018:1.source_cn: 战争结束了，人们一代代传承，总会慢慢遗忘伤痛，归于平静...

say:20:1310814019:0.text: The flames of war burn in our hearts and torture our souls unceasingly. Eternal pain is the price for eternal life.
say:20:1310814019:0.source_cn: 战火毫不停息地灼烧着我们的内心，折磨着我们的灵魂——永...

say:21:1310814020:0.text: My companions were never afraid of the Hypogeans, but they could not resist the pain throughout the millennia. They were devoured by anguish and torment, lost themselves, became the undead you see before you.
say:21:1310814020:0.source_cn: 我的战友们……他们无惧恶魔的威胁，却无法抵抗这样的痛苦...

say:22:1310814021:0.text: The people remain utterly ignorant of what happened and regard us as minions of the Hypogeans. I harbor no resentment toward them, yet I cannot help but feel a sense of helplessness and betrayal.
say:22:1310814021:0.source_cn: 人们对这一切毫不知情，将我们视作恶魔的眷属、邪恶的化身...

say:24:1310814023:0.text: ... Let us make our way to the center of the battlefield.
say:24:1310814023:0.source_cn: ……来吧，我带你们去战场中心看看。

say:26:1310814016:0.text: Wait, so that means all the undead here were once able to think and talk like you...
say:26:1310814016:0.source_cn: 咦，这么说，那些活死人曾经和你一样有自我意识？

choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 原来你们是这样成为亡灵的

say:27:1310814007:0.text: Due to the fear of mortality, due to our ire at our foe... and due to our reluctance to yield.
say:27:1310814007:0.source_cn: 因为对死亡的恐惧，因为对敌人的愤怒……还因为，不甘心。
say:27:1310814007:0.male: Due to the fear of mortality, due to our ire at our foe... and due to our reluctance to yield.
say:27:1310814007:0.female: Due to the fear of mortality, due to our ire at our foe... and due to our reluctance to yield.

choice:7:1:2.text: How did you all become undead?
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 你们为何会变成“活死人”？
choice:7:1:2.male: How did you all become undead?
choice:7:1:2.female: How did you all become undead?

say:1:1310815002:0.text: Yes, the final and most brutal battle took place here.
say:1:1310815002:0.source_cn: 嗯，最后的、也是最惨烈的战役就发生在这里。

say:0:1310816001:0.text: There are so many weapons and broken pieces of armor here!
say:0:1310816001:0.source_cn: 周围有好大的武器和盔甲！

say:1:1310816002:0.text: I can't believe there was such a huge Hypogean back then...
say:1:1310816002:0.source_cn: 原来当时曾有那么巨大的恶魔啊……

say:1:1310817001:0.text: It's really strange here. Chippy almost hears the sounds of swords clashing and warhorses charging in the wind!
say:1:1310817001:0.source_cn: 这里真的很奇怪，好像吹来的风里都有刀剑碰撞和战马冲锋的...

say:2:1310817002:1.text: This is the final field of battle, where an endless number of the dead have been laid to rest, so numerous that the resolve and scent of iron and blood have yet to fade.
say:2:1310817002:1.source_cn: 这是最后的战场，这里埋葬过太多的尸骨，多到铁与血的意志...

say:3:1310817003:0.text: It was here that I met my end...

say:5:1310817004:0.text: Have all your companions become undead and forgotten who they are?
say:5:1310817004:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，你所有的战友都失去理智，成为活死人了吗？<ke...

say:6:1310817005:1.text: Yes, the majority of them. A few endeavor to cling to their final vestige of reason, yet they may not be able to maintain their grip for much longer.
say:6:1310817005:1.source_cn: 是的，几乎所有。还有些人仍旧努力保持着最后的理智，但…...

say:7:1310817006:0.text: Lady Valka, how come you were able to hold on for so long?

say:11:1310817010:0.source_cn: ……当年的营地，现在已经是沼泽中的废墟了。

say:1:1310818001:0.source_cn: 这里真的很奇怪，好像吹来的风里都有刀剑碰撞和战马冲锋的...

say:2:1310818002:1.source_cn: 这是最后的战场，这里埋葬过太多的尸骨，多到铁与血的意志...

say:3:1310818003:0.text: It was here that I met my end...

say:5:1310818004:0.text: Have all your companions become undead and forgotten who they are?
say:5:1310818004:0.source_cn: 瓦丽卡，你所有的战友都失去理智，成为活死人了吗？<ke...

say:6:1310818005:1.source_cn: 是的，几乎所有。还有些人仍旧努力保持着最后的理智，但…...

say:7:1310818006:0.text: Oh, we saw one of the undead in the ruins to the north. He kept muttering words like "follow" and "fight." We got this medal from him.
say:7:1310818006:0.source_cn: 啊，我们在北边的废墟里见过一个活死人，他念叨着“追随”...

choice_prompt:8:1310818006.source_cn: 啊，我们在北边的废墟里见过一个活死人，他念叨着“追随”、“战斗”之类的话语。还有这枚勋章……是我们从他身上……获得的。

say:12:1310818009:0.text: You must have encountered Zavros. He was the most valiant and steadfast knight in my service. I myself bestowed this medal upon him. In a single battle, he once dispatched thirty-three Hypofiends. His prowess was truly remarkable.
say:12:1310818009:0.source_cn: 你们遇到的应该是扎维沙，当年我麾下最为忠诚英勇的骑士。...

say:13:1310818010:1.text: Did he also die in battle and transform into a Graveborn?
say:13:1310818010:1.source_cn: 他后来也是战死，又被死神大人变成亡灵的吗？

say:14:1310818011:1.text: Yes, he was always at the forefront of battle, and no foe could bar his path until... until he tried to shield me and was impaled by the Frost Furie...
say:14:1310818011:1.source_cn: 是的，他永远都冲锋在最前面，任何敌人都无法阻止他，直到...

say:16:1310818013:1.source_cn: ……不，不用道歉。我相信扎维沙那样的骑士也不愿一直浑浑...

say:17:1310818014:1.text: Lady Valka, how come you were able to hold on for so long?
say:17:1310818014:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡女士，你为什么和他们不一样，能保持清醒呢？<ke...

say:18:1310818015:1.source_cn: 我？呵，或许因为我是个懦夫吧……<key:dialog2>

say:21:1310818018:1.text: Come, let us make our way to the last resting place of those brave warriors.
say:21:1310818018:1.source_cn: ……看看那些英勇的战士们如今仅剩的归宿。

say:0:1310818101:0.text: Come with me, we'll take the boat to the old camp.
say:0:1310818101:0.source_cn: 跟我来，我们坐船去旧营地。

say:1:1310819001:0.text: We're so sorry, Lady Valka. He was wearing armor very similar to yours. He must've been one of your comrades.
say:1:1310819001:0.source_cn: 对不起……瓦丽卡女士，他穿着和你很像的盔甲，肯定也是你...

say:2:1310819002:0.source_cn: 满满也不想这样的，可是他突然攻击我们……

say:3:1310819003:1.text: No apology is necessary. The undead, once their sanity is lost, will prey upon the innocent. I was powerless to prevent it, and I lack the heart to slay them.
say:3:1310819003:1.source_cn: 不，不需要道歉。失去理智的活死人会攻击无辜生灵。我无法...

say:4:1310819004:0.source_cn: 这样对他们来说才是真正的解脱。

say:6:1310819005:0.text: Oh, look! "Oh Goddess, please bless Kaminsky", is this some sort of talisman?
say:6:1310819005:0.source_cn: 咦，“女神保佑扬·卡明斯基”……这似乎是个护身符？

say:8:1310819006:1.text: This fell from him. It must be important.
say:8:1310819006:1.source_cn: 这是从他身上掉下来的，这一定对他很重要！

say:10:1310819007:1.text: Kaminsky... I recall that he was a fervent youth, scarce 20 years of age. He had been wed for less than a year when he took to the battlefield.
say:10:1310819007:1.source_cn: 扬·卡明斯基……我记得他，一个还不满20岁的、热血沸腾...

say:11:1310819008:0.source_cn: 卡明斯基家当年是个大家族，或许现在白山还有他们的后裔。

say:12:1310819009:0.text: Maybe after this matter is over, we can go look for his family and return the talisman to them.
say:12:1310819009:0.source_cn: 嗯……也许这件事结束以后，可以去找找，将这个护身符还给他们。

say:1:1310820001:0.text: It seems like you really have nothing to do with the strange time loop...

say:3:1310820002:1.text: Were it not for you, I would've remained ignorant of the events that transpired in Cedartown.

say:3:1310820002:1.female: Were it not for you, I would've remained ignorant of the events that transpired in Cedartown.

say:4:1310820004:0.text: This "time loop", as you called it, reminds me of the Frost Furie... Her powers and the coldness she wrought could even freeze time itself.

say:5:1310820005:1.text: Freeze time? But how could time be frozen?!

say:6:1310820006:1.text: I am uncertain... The ways of the Hypogean elude me. But this has claimed the lives of numerous warriors.

choice:2:0:1.text: Have you seen anything odd lately?

choice:2:0:1.male: Have you seen anything odd lately?
choice:2:0:1.female: Have you seen anything odd lately?

say:11:1310820003:1.text: No, I've not heard of such a thing in the two thousand years I've been here.

choice_prompt:3:1310822002.text: They've all gone crazy! Evil has inhabited their hearts!

choice:3:1:2.text: You look like the crazy one.
choice:3:1:2.male: You look like the crazy one.
choice:3:1:2.female: You look like the crazy one.

say:0:1310823001:0.text: Please lead the way. We need to check out the situation.

say:1:1310826001:0.source_cn: 艾雅啊，求您原谅这几位兄弟姊妹，他们受邪恶诱惑，偏离了...

say:11:1310826007:0.source_cn: 艾雅啊，求您倾听您虔诚信徒的声音，为他赐下圣光，使他不...

say:5:1310829003:0.source_cn: 不过，我们还不知道这个祭坛的构建方式……

say:6:1310829004:1.text: Let us look around. The cultists may have left some clues.
say:6:1310829004:1.source_cn: 在周围找找，这个祭坛不简单，布置它的邪教徒们或许会留下...

say:8:1310829005:1.text: You guys search! Chippy will hold back these Hypofiends!
say:8:1310829005:1.source_cn: 你们赶紧寻找，满满先来挡住这些魔物！

choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 防护层的魔力是从别处而来

choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 得找到防护魔力的来源

say:0:1310829101:0.source_cn: 如果有线索，可能会在这附近……

say:0:1310830001:0.text: I've got it! The magic comes from that special Hypofiend and the magic circle on the ground!
say:0:1310830001:0.source_cn: 我明白了！供给魔力的就是那个<style=highli...

say:0:1310830101:0.source_cn: 还要破坏<style=highlight>地上的魔法阵...

say:1:1310832001:0.text: Dura above... You must've been sent by the goddess herself! Her wrath has repelled the evil from this place!
say:1:1310832001:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上……你们、你们一定是女神的使者，是祂降给邪恶的怒火！

say:2:1310832002:0.text: I am Acolyte Callahan of St. Kinga's Temple. Greetings, and may Dura bless you all.
say:2:1310832002:0.source_cn: 我，圣金嘉教堂的修士杨凯维奇，向你们致意。愿艾雅保佑你们。

choice_prompt:3:1310832002.text: I am Acolyte Callahan of St. Kinga's Temple. Greetings, and may Dura bless you all.
choice_prompt:3:1310832002.source_cn: 我，圣金嘉教堂的修士杨凯维奇，向你们致意。愿艾雅保佑你们。

say:4:1310832003:0.text: I apologize for earlier. I was frightened out of my wits. To be honest, my knees are still shaking a bit...

say:4:1310832003:0.female: I apologize for earlier. I was frightened out of my wits. To be honest, my knees are still shaking a bit...

say:8:1310832007:1.source_cn: 结果却看到他们……我的兄弟姊妹们……穿着奇怪的服装，好...

say:9:1310832008:0.source_cn: 当时我吓坏了，拔腿就跑……还好，还好遇上了你们。赞美艾...

say:11:1310832009:0.text: This bears the hallmarks of a Hypogean ritual.
say:11:1310832009:0.source_cn: ……这种感觉，是恶魔的仪式，我绝对不会认错！

say:12:1310832010:1.text: I'm scared to stay here. Could you please take me to St. Valesa's Temple nearby?
say:12:1310832010:1.source_cn: 那个，我、我实在不敢留在这里了，能请你们送我去附近的圣...

say:13:1310832011:0.text: It's just <style="highlight">a short distance along this road</style>. Please! Dura bless you!

say:15:1310832012:1.text: Wait a minute. This altar is related to a Hypogean. Perhaps this ritual is related to the time loop in Cedartown...
say:15:1310832012:1.source_cn: 祭坛和恶魔有关，恶魔……或许，这个仪式和雪松镇的时间循...

subtitle:1:1311085004:.text: You're the hero this festival was meant to honor!
subtitle:1:1311085004:.source_cn: 你是祭典纪念的那位英雄！
